nodes.label: planet() pixel-planet renderer
nodes.rationale: Seeded value noise so the planet looks the same on every visit; ~20fps loop is enough for pixel art and kind to laptops.

nodes.label: Concurrent clones with live cancel / retry
nodes.norm_label: concurrent clones with live cancel / retry

nodes.label: Release Workflow (dist)
nodes.rationale: Autogenerated by cargo-dist; triggered by workflow_dispatch with a tag (or pull_request for a dry-run plan) and publishes a GitHub Release with archives, installers and hashes.

nodes.label: Semantic Release Workflow
nodes.rationale: Every push to main runs tests then lets semantic-release pick the next version from commit messages, so nobody bumps versions by hand.

nodes.label: Clone from here (browser form)
nodes.rationale: Browsers cannot run git, so the page mirrors the app's parsing rules (src/repo.rs) and emits a command or script to paste; the token only goes to api.github.com and is never put into output.

nodes.label: Error classification (LC_ALL=C)
nodes.rationale: LC_ALL=C keeps git messages in English so classification into actionable errors works on any machine.

nodes.label: Org / user repo picker
nodes.rationale: Uses curl with the token on stdin so it stays off the command line; everything ticked except forks and archived repos.

nodes.label: Token env vars (GITCLONER_PAT, GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, GITLAB_TOKEN)
nodes.norm_label: token env vars (gitcloner_pat, github_token, gh_token, gitlab_token)
nodes.rationale: No token CLI flag because gitcloner stays open and argv is readable in ps the whole time; host-scoped tokens only go to their own host.

nodes.label: workflow_dispatch handoff to Release
nodes.rationale: A tag pushed with GITHUB_TOKEN cannot trigger other workflows, but workflow_dispatch via `gh workflow run` is allowed.

nodes.label: Fail-fast auth (GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, SSH BatchMode)
nodes.rationale: A private repo without credentials fails immediately instead of hanging on a prompt or credential manager.

nodes.label: GIT_ASKPASS token handoff
nodes.rationale: The binary answers git's credential prompt from an env var so the token never appears on the command line, in .git/config, or in logs.

nodes.label: dist-manifest.json
nodes.rationale: Manifest passed between jobs as artifacts; plan output drives the build matrix and host output drives release title/body/prerelease flag.

nodes.label: Tagline: clone many repos at once - public or private
nodes.norm_label: tagline: clone many repos at once - public or private

nodes.label: gitcloner --update (self-update)
nodes.rationale: Runs the platform installer and replaces the binary in place; on Windows the running .exe is moved aside first since it cannot be overwritten.

nodes.label: GitCloner Open Graph Social Card
nodes.rationale: 1200x630 social preview for the docs site: pixel-art planet rising over a starfield, monospace GITCLONER title and tagline, dark navy background with teal/cyan accents and gold sparkle stars to give a retro terminal/space brand feel.

nodes.label: Background update check
nodes.rationale: One curl --head to releases/latest: no API quota, no token sent, 5s limit, silent offline; GITCLONER_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 disables it.
